items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story about Joe Glaser and Louis Armstrong ('He sold Louie to Joe Glaser... Glaser was a go-getter... Louie used to tell him...'). The interviewee (Barney Bigard) is not described as having a direct personal interaction with Joe Glaser, but rather is recounting the relatio

ctx.x: Yeah, and, well, Joe took all that abuse from the crackers down there. But he's quite a salesman, too, you know. And if you don't know Glaser, you would swear he was about the worst gangster in the world, and the guy, he's got a big heart, too, a real nice guy. But you have to know him.

And you should hear he and Louie arguing together. Louie said that's his father. He said that Joe Glasser was his father, "we understand each other." I wished they did understand each other. They'd cuss each other out, I'd swear I couldn't understand that part.
Were they friends before Joe bought his contract?
